children.text: Melissa Qin is a Harvard Medical student and social media influencer. She describes herself in her TikTok bio as a “fashion addict & harvard med m2,” with her personal brand involving being a successful medical student who also balances time for regular exercise, self-care, and a curated fashion sense. Her content style rotates between medical student content and lifestyle content, including anything between fashion, travel, and her personal life. She often blurs the line between these two niches, posting popular trend videos with a medical student slant. She is considered a macroinfluencer on TikTok, with 111.2K followers. Melissa’s intended audience is pre-medical and medical students looking for advice to maintain a healthy lifestyle while also managing a rigorous course load. However, some comments on her medical school posts state “I have ZERO medical knowledge/schooling but would love to hear someone nerd out about it everyday. Makes it more exciting hearing it so passionately from another person than reading about it🤷🏻‍♀️,” and “me listening to this whole video while in architecture school.” As a whole, she attracts an actual audience who may or may not be interested in the medical field but are curious to learn more about it, and individuals who enjoy viewing her lifestyle content outside of medicine.
